checks.name: V34 modules boot on the selected storage surface
Inventory protects persistent, unknown and in-memory draft references
Media names are literal text, never inserted as HTML
Cleanup requires explicit selection and backup acknowledgement
Selection alone is not destructive authorization
Selection plus acknowledgement enables requested cleanup
Exported inventory contains metadata and references, not binary payloads
Any committed change marks the open inventory stale
Rescanning does not silently reselect previously checked media
Transaction recheck preserves a newly referenced runtime asset
Real IDB abort after deletion request restores bytes and emits no successful commit
Confirmed cleanup removes only the selected orphan
Cleanup leaves songs and charts identical
A missing reference is visible and disables destructive cleanup
AudioContext suspension pauses the live game and clears source inputs
Suspended input cannot score or arm a held source
AudioContext recovery alone does not restart a paused game
Explicit resume starts the same paused song
Multiple hold gauges remain readable with all decorative VFX off
Hold HUD redraws do not alter score or replay data
Hold status stays within the narrow viewport
Releasing one hold does not clear a second lane gauge
A closed audio context is recreated safely on explicit resume
Hold-gauge preference persists through its settings handler
Hiding the document pauses the actual Director audition without discarding the draft
Returning visible leaves the Director paused until explicitly resumed
Director can resume normally after an interruption
No uncaught browser errors in V34 flow

scope: Native Web Audio and HTTP/IndexedDB transactional test. Software GPU and viewport emulation, not device certification.
